d:
In this video I explore the ground reality of the world’s poorest country (BURUNDI) and try to understand what life is really like beyond the headlines.
From busy local markets to small neighborhoods, from visiting homes to observing daily struggles, I go deep into how people live, work, and survive. I also show unique parts of daily life, including cycle taxis, fuel shortages, and the challenges people face every single day.
Along the way, I share facts, history, and real experiences to understand how the situation reached this point and what life looks like today.
